nom: bareMinerals SKINLONGEVITY Revitalizing Eye Cream with Niacinamide

segments.sensitive: The large majority of reviewers who mention their own skin describe it as sensitive, especially around the eyes, and consistently report no burning, stinging or irritation, including reviewers who say most eye creams make their skin react.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s and 50s report using the cream against fine lines, dark circles and puffiness, generally noting gradual brightening and smoothing after a few weeks of consistent use.
segments.dry: The one reviewer who specifically describes dry, mature under-eye skin found the cream's thicker consistency worked well to lock in moisture from her eye serum.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly softer fine lines and a firmer, smoother under-eye area within two to four weeks of twice-daily use, but a substantial share, especially among the lower-starred reviews, say they saw no change in fine lines or firmness despite liking how the product feels.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the cream as effectively hydrating and non-greasy, though one reviewer wished the formula were creamier and more moisturizing.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report their dark circles looked visibly brighter or less noticeable after consistent use, but others, including one who tried it for two and a half weeks, say they saw little to no change in their dark circles.

extraits.texte: There's some positives however there are more negative. Here are the pros and cons in my opinion : PROS: I love the packaging I think its sleek and classy. Dries quickly when applied. Is not sticky or heavy. Hydrates area applied CONS: I saw zero results. Jar doesn't close tightly Yellowish and dried out slightly when opened Used daily with no change. Application area was dried out n sensitive after use of 6 days consecutive. Too small of amount in jar

This claims to help with eye dark circles and under eye bags. Ive been using it 2x a day for about two and a half weeks. I noticed a slight difference in my under eye bags. I didn't really see much difference in my dark circles. It comes in a small jar and it wasn't easy to get the product out. It's not a heavy cream which is good in this heat. I'm going to keep using to use it up but I wouldn't rebuy.

extraits.titre: A nice cream in a nice package
extraits.texte: I received Bare Minerals SKINLONGEVITY Revitalizing Eye Cream with Niacinemide from BzzAgent in exchange for an honest review. Now, everyone proclaims that thy have sensitive skin. Well, I'm the real deal! A lot of products make me feel like I set a flame to my face. I've been hesitant to try anything with nicinamide, but I figured, what the heck, let's give it a whirl! I can't speak to its anti-aging effects, because that takes longer than the time frame allowed to submit a review. I can, however speak to the experience. The cream is thicker, but not so much that it leaves a waxy layer or great effort at rubbing it in (Think Tatcha). It did NOT burn! I was able to leave it on! I was surprised. I've been using it for a little while and it provides moisture, is inoffensive with its fragrance, and has a cute spa-esque packaging. I am open to purchasing this in the future. I feel safe recommending it to the gals out there with TRULY sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: Really hydrating, great for daily wear - gentle formula
extraits.texte: I received this product in return for my honest review so I wanted to be sure to use it for a few weeks before writing this. I will say my eye area typically is very sensitive and this did not irritate it at all. The area felt super moisturized and I found I had slightly less fine lines than usual after prolonged use. Has a very mild scent too which I appreciate. Overall I will definitely continue use because it's extremely hydrating and seems to firm up the area.

Bare Minerals makes really great products and their Revitalizing eye cream is no exception. This is a very light cream and a little goes a very long way. The product is scent free and non irritating to the eyes. I am 52 years old and experiencing several issues around my eyes. First, it helped moisturize the area which decreased fine lines. My skin was definitely improved and visibly brighter. Any puffiness to the area was drastically decreased. The more stubborn dark circles showed marked improvement. I still wish there was something that would totally erase those circles. The following picture is without make up except for mascara. Overall, I am definitely impressed. I will purchase this product in the future.

extraits.titre: No irritating and hides fine lines!
extraits.texte: I love the spare minerals eye cream. I am extremely sensitive around my eye area and I have to be very selective and any eye cream that I try. This ice cream was so soothing in very much non-irritating. My skin often burns when I put on eye cream, even if it's labeled for sensitive skin. However, this ice cream was as if I was dabbing on water. I did not feel it at all, and it quickly soaked into my eye area. I found it to be non-greasy and easily absorbed into my skin. I've been using it for almost 2 weeks now, and I can already tell improvement in the fine lines around my eyes. I love the fact that it is made with natural ingredients that are healthy to my skin. Overall, I highly recommend adding this bareMinerals eye cream to your beauty routine. It is a fantastic edition, especially for sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: Great product for dry mature undereye
extraits.texte: I have been using this product for a few weeks day and night. I usually apply after eye serums to lock in moisture. This eye cream has a thick consistency with a refreshing smell. A little goes a long way. Plan to purchase again.
